topic: Monitoring system health check and data logging
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on checking the functionality of a monitoring system, specifically involving `graphyte` sending data to `mon.allunite.local`. Initially, there was concern about missing data logs in DataLog and connection timeouts from the main monitor (`mon`). Later, it was determined that the issue stemmed from the monitoring system running out of memory.
decisions: The health check process was successfully run and confirmed to be working.
